messages:
maya: FYI starting a coordinated rebuild of the runtime base image to pick up the libsec update that fixes CVE-2026-0421. will do a canary push to dedicated first. pinging infra + sec for RBAC/audit checks.
sam: thanks — any ETA on the canary? :eyes:
maya: canary build + test tonight, canary deploy 02:00 UTC, full rollout tomorrow morning if green. keeping it small (2 nodes) and route ~1% traffic.
charles: quick Q on KMS: will the image signing step use the existing project KMS key or the new key we discussed for private customers?
maya: using project key for public/dedicated; private customers still use customer-managed KMS. signing step is in the pipeline after `docker push`.
anya: need RBAC change to allow the image-builder SA to call KMS.sign. I'll open a PR to the iam repo, but we should standardize the minimal binding.
sam: suggested binding:

```
resource: projects/infra-prod/serviceAccounts/image-builder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
role: roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier
```

can we do `conditions` to limit to the signing key? (prefer least privilege)
charles: yes add condition on `resource.name` -> projects/infra-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/signing-key
sec-bot: vuln-scan: image-builder: base-runtime: found packages with 2 medium vulns (openssl CVE-2026-0310, curl CVE-2026-0233). See /scans/1776004321.
maya: thanks sec-bot — openssl patched in the rebuild. curl we need to upgrade and re-run image-scan. priority 2.
anya: audit logging: make sure Audit Log Sink includes ObjectAccess for the registry bucket and KMS Admin logs for key use. otherwise we won't have an audit trail for signing operations.
sam: added note to infra runbook, will enable Data Access logs for `projects/infra-prod` and route to sec-audit-log project. Command I used:

```
gcloud logging sinks create sec-audit gs://sec-audit-logs --log-filter="logName:cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access" --project=infra-prod
```

maya: perfect.
charles: incident tie-in: the runtime OOM in eu-west-1 last week was partly due to a sidecar using an older glibc; the rebuild will drop in the newer glibc too. ops, please correlate.
oncall-devops: noted, I'll annotate the incident ticket (#INC-20260314-07) with the rebuild plan and schedule a post-deploy probe (heap + fd checks).
maya: rollout checklist I'm following (short):
- build base image (`./ci/build-base.sh`) -> push to staging
- run `image-scan` -> if fails, abort
- sign image -> push to private registry
- deploy canary to dedicated pool
- run smoke + e2e
- escalate if any alerts in 30m

sam: tiny recommendation: please add the new KMS key IAM change as a separate change in the PR so infra review can approve quickly.
maya: will do. also tagging @security for final thumbs.
sec-bot: policy-check: iam-policy-pr: #1245 opened by anya. status: pending reviewers: eng-iam, sec.
anya: PR link: https://git.redwood.internal/iam/pulls/1245 — includes condition on key resource and limited role.
charles: after canary, we should run a quick runtime-fuzz on canary nodes for 1 hour (simulate concurrency bumps) — I'll prepare the job.
maya: great. if canary passes, aim for gradual rollout 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 6 hours.
sam: thanks everyone. I'll watch the deploy and escalate if the canary errors spike.
maya: closing the loop: I'll post a short summary in #eng-runtime after completion and attach the image digest + signed metadata. :white_check_mark:
